full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media comic painting shows a slender adult figure from hat to upper thighs, standing slightly left of center. The person wears a tall dark top hat pulled low over a face mostly concealed in charcoal shadow. Black tousled hair escapes below the brim, and the head inclines down toward the left. A vivid red coat hangs open over a pale white shirt and a long dark blue-black necktie or scarf. A wide dark belt with a small metal buckle wraps the waist. One hand rests near the pocket while the other hangs low, both only partly defined by expressive dark strokes. The figure stands against an uneven vertical field: mostly off-white paper on the left, a broad hot orange and rust-red painted wall or abstract plane on the right. In the upper right, a second face-like fragment appears faintly within the orange paint, as though a sketch or print layer remains under the surface. Drips, ink flecks, scratches, and rubbed patches break the red and white areas. The lower edge is especially incomplete, with body and background dissolving into smears rather than a clean finish. A thin dark vertical line near the left margin acts as a graphic border. Strong contrast between the dark hat and the pale ground makes the hidden face a focus. The coat's saturated red is the largest color accent, while cool blues, black, and warm orange distribute the rest of the palette. The scene does not define a room or street. It feels more like a psychological character study than a narrative moment, with a still posture made restless by unstable paint. No readable lettering appears. The image combines precise costume cues with deliberately distressed, layered surfaces.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒材漫画绘画描绘一位细瘦成年人，从帽顶到大腿上部，站在中央偏左。他戴深色高礼帽，帽檐压低，使脸大多藏在炭灰阴影中。凌乱黑发从檐下露出，头向左下倾。一件鲜红外套敞开，内有浅白衬衫和长长深蓝黑领带或围巾。宽深色皮带以小金属扣束住腰。一只手靠近口袋，另一只低垂，二者都只由表现性暗笔部分界定。身后竖向画域不均匀：左边多为米白纸，右边是宽阔热橙、锈红颜料墙面或抽象平面。右上方另有一块淡淡脸状碎影藏在橙色里，像底层草图或印刷层留在表面。滴痕、墨点、刮痕和擦损斑块打破红白区域。下缘尤其未完成，身体与背景融成涂抹，而非整齐收尾。左边缘附近一条细深竖线像图形边界。深帽和浅底的强对照让隐藏的脸成为焦点。外套的饱和红是最大色彩重音，冷蓝、黑与暖橙分布其他画面。场景没有界定室内或街道。它更像心理角色研究而非叙事瞬间，静姿因不稳定颜料而显得躁动。没有可读文字。图像把明确服装线索与刻意斑驳的分层表面结合。
style_prompt_en: The expressive mixed-media comic treatment layers charcoal drawing, rough red-orange paint, off-white paper, cool blue accents, ink flecks, and rubbed scratches. A narrow dark vertical silhouette emerges from a split warm-cool ground; its upper contour is sharp while lower passages dissolve into incomplete smears. One large saturated red mass gives color impact, balanced by generous pale space and distressed orange texture. Facial information is withheld under a strong shadow shape, shifting attention to gesture and costume-like graphic forms. Drips, ghost images, irregular edge losses, and sketchy lines make the surface feel revised and unstable. The composition is still but psychologically charged, combining a few precise details with deliberately raw paint.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒材漫画处理叠加炭灰素描、粗糙红橙颜料、米白纸、冷蓝重音、墨点和擦损刮痕。窄深色竖向剪影从分裂的暖冷背景浮出；上部轮廓清楚，下部段落融成未完成涂抹。一大片饱和红造成色彩冲击，由宽敞浅色空间和斑驳橙肌理平衡。面部信息被强阴影形隐藏，注意力转向姿态和服装般图形。滴痕、幽灵般底影、不规则缺边和草写线让表面显得经过修改而不稳定。构图静止却有心理电压，把少数精确细节与刻意生猛颜料并置。
theme_en: A shadowed top-hatted figure in red stands against distressed orange and white paint
theme_zh: 戴高帽的暗影人物身披红衣，立于斑驳橙白颜料前
name: Bill Sienkiewicz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
